programs.name: ackermann
programs.source: (define (ack m n) (cond ((= m 0) (+ n 1)) ((= n 0) (ack (- m 1) 1)) (else (ack (- m 1) (ack m (- n 1)))))) (display (ack 2 3))

programs.name: mutual recursion
programs.source: (define (my-even? n) (if (= n 0) #t (my-odd? (- n 1)))) (define (my-odd? n) (if (= n 0) #f (my-even? (- n 1)))) (display (my-even? 10)) (display (my-odd? 7))

programs.name: power
programs.source: (define (pow b e) (if (= e 0) 1 (* b (pow b (- e 1))))) (display (pow 2 16))

programs.name: builds a list
programs.source: (define (range a b) (if (>= a b) '() (cons a (range (+ a 1) b)))) (display (range 0 5))

programs.name: gcd
programs.source: (define (gcd a b) (if (= b 0) a (gcd b (modulo a b)))) (display (gcd 48 18))

programs.name: flatten
programs.source: (define (flatten x) (cond ((null? x) '()) ((pair? x) (append (flatten (car x)) (flatten (cdr x)))) (else (list x)))) (display (flatten '(1 (2 (3 4)) ((5)))))
